title: The Obsolescence of High-Level Code: Agentic Generation from Semantic Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2611.23249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper argues that high-level source code need not remain the primary persistent artifact of software development when AI agents can generate, validate, and regenerate executable implementations from semantic intent. We place this claim in historical context by revisiting application generators, CASE tools, model-driven development, and platforms such as GeneXus, where developers already maintained higher-level representations from which code and other artifacts were derived.   We propose a unifying view in which generation is the fundamental operation: given a semantic specification S = (R, C, I, T, O), maintained as the semantic authority, an agent produces a generated executable artifact A. Functional requirements, contracts, and interfaces are assessed as semantic obligations, while tests and operational objectives are assessed by an explicit external oracle V(A, S). translated_title: 高级代码的过时：从语义工件进行智能体生成
translated_abstract: 本文认为，当AI智能体能够从语义意图生成、验证并重新生成可执行实现时，高级源代码无需再作为软件开发的主要持久工件。我们通过重新审视应用程序生成器、CASE工具、模型驱动开发以及GeneXus等平台，将这一论点置于历史背景之中——在这些平台中，开发者早已维护着更高层次的表示形式，代码和其他工件皆由此派生而来。我们提出了一个统一的观点，其中生成是基本操作：给定作为语义权威维护的语义规范 S = (R, C, I, T, O)，智能体据此产出一个生成的可执行工件 A。功能需求、契约和接口被视为语义义务加以评估，而测试和运营目标则由显式的外部预言机 V(A, S) 进行评估。我们通过一个实验将该框架付诸实践……
tldr: 本文提出当AI智能体能够从作为语义权威的语义规范出发生成、验证和重新生成可执行实现时，高级源代码将不再是软件开发的主要持久工件，“生成”将成为软件开发的基本操作。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that high-level source code need no longer be the primary persistent artifact of software development, as AI agents can generate, validate, and regenerate executable implementations from semantic specifications, making generation the fundamental operation of software development.
